instruction: Enable location services in Ubuntu's privacy settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling location services. Config sets location enabled to false initially, user must change it to true. Evaluator checks gsettings value is 'true'. No custom functions needed - uses existing get_vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_vm_command_line to execute 'gsettings get org.gnome.system.location enabled' which directly reads the location services state
Expected value 'true\n' correctly includes the newline that gsettings command returns
Metric exact_match appropriately compares the command output against expected value
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling location services, evaluator verifies location services are enabled
No state timing issues: gsettings values persist after user action, no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct: command execution returns output string, exact_match compares result == expected
